claims.drop: Zach Ertz (35, TE, PHI — 36.7 season / 3.0 wk3; won for $0 last night and is the FOURTH tight end on a roster with ONE TE slot, behind Likely, Helm and Ferguson)
claims.why: The move of the night in this league and the only league in the portfolio where he is still free. Wilson is the #1 trending add in all of fantasy (1.98M) and the mechanism verifies on Sleeper's own wire, independent of any expert: Jadarian Price (SEA RB1) left Sunday with a chest injury and is Questionable, George Holani's snap share FELL from 46% to 26% week 1 to 2, and Wilson took 21 carries for 92 yards in relief. If Price sits he is the Seattle lead back; if Price plays he is the clear 1B. Guillotine rules invert the stash rule — every spot must produce now — and a contingent lead back on a team whose starter is Questionable produces now. BID: $231 of an UNTOUCHED $1000. Sober tier for a strong role bet is 15-25% ($150-250); Weeks 1-6 aggression adds 5-10% to WIN rather than to have a chance; odd number per standing rule. Nobody in this league bid on him last night, so $231 is very likely more than enough — that is the point. SKIP: Ted Hurst (TB WR4, 5.7, the 17%-target-share rookie from the FF transcript) — speculative, and guillotine spots cannot hold speculation.
